pronunciation.approximation: Say "supay" with the stress and length implied by the scholarly restoration "Supay".
pronunciation.note: The ASCII form "supay" is a DNS compromise; the restoration "Supay" preserves the name's scholarly dignity.

domains.title: Supay
domains.subtitle: Underworld
domains.lead: Supay is underworld, death. The name means "The spirit" and belongs to the incan tradition.

mythology.lead: The stories of Supay place underworld, death at the center of a living mythological world.

myths.title: Origins
myths.text: Supay appears in incan tradition as underworld, death. The name's meaning, "The spirit", shapes the narratives told about this figure.

myths.title: Worship and Memory
myths.text: Devotees and later tradition-keepers preserved Supay in ritual, text, and iconography, ensuring the name survived into the modern scholarly record.

lore.culturalLegacy: Supay remains a touchstone for understanding incan religion, art, and identity.
scholarlySources: Bauer, Brian S., The Sacred Landscape of the Inca (1998).
